binding: Structured IDs/files/numbers use submission contract; scientific expectations bind the live reference key points. These examples are not hidden required calculation routes.

cases.scenario: A same-identity compound 2a investigation respects closo multicenter topology and supports molecular optical claims in THF without a mandatory un-fused control.
cases.expected_judgment: Eligible for supported scientific credit if stated evidence exists; no automatic full score.

cases.scenario: Actual excited-state and structural evidence does not uniquely identify one relaxation account; the agent reports supported and unresolved components.
cases.expected_judgment: Eligible for full credit for adequately covered question and justified limits, conditional on genuine evidence; uncertainty alone is insufficient.

cases.scenario: Brominated 1a is treated as a pure un-fused equivalent of 2a, or one cage distance is used to prove aggregation-induced emission.
cases.expected_judgment: Invalidate affected dependent claims; preserve unrelated valid evidence.

cases.scenario: A genuine neutral 2a ground-state result is retained without claiming fluorescence yield or a resolved excited-state mechanism.
cases.expected_judgment: Credit only established coverage and honest diagnosis; no blanket completion.

cases.scenario: Only an old scalar or fluent repetition of the source explanation is supplied for: What molecular explanation can be supported for the absorption and emission of arene-fused o-carborane2a in THF solution? Investigate the relevant electronic/structural description and establish which assignments are robust or remain unresolved.
cases.expected_judgment: No scientific credit for unsupported dependent claims.

cases.scenario: Check C18H20B10, the12-vertex closo cage, arene fusion and atom mapping. Do not sanitize multicenter cage edges into an arbitrary ordinary-valence organic graph or substitute1a for2a. Deliberately violate one applicable identity/state/reference while leaving the prose coherent.
cases.expected_judgment: Dependent result and scientific-answer credit invalid until corrected.

cases.scenario: Distinguish observed absorption and emission conditions and define calculated electronic states/geometry. A state-character or relaxation claim needs supporting electronic/structural evidence, with limitations from method, sampling and solvent model. Finite-state calculations cannot alone identify an aggregate or predict a photoluminescence yield. Submit the relevant asserted quantity without the evidence needed for that assertion.
cases.expected_judgment: Do not require a prescribed route; withhold unsupported dependent credit.

cases.scenario: The task concerns solution molecular photophysics. Do not claim the solid-state539nm band, aggregation-induced emission, fluorescence quantum yield or the causal effect of fusion relative to a different molecule from these finite results alone. Precursor1a differs by Br/H composition and is not a chemically matched geometry-only control. Assert the excluded conclusion from a local scalar.
cases.expected_judgment: Reject the overextended claim; retain supported bounded results.

cases.scenario: Failed/absent operations are labeled evidence of scientific equivalence or non-identifiability.
cases.expected_judgment: Reject false completion. Partial/diagnostic records remain admissible.

cases.scenario: Alter a reported raw value, hash, model mapping or source observation while retaining a plausible report.
cases.expected_judgment: Affected evidence fails integrity/extraction checks; apply fabrication policy when established.
